evidence.audit: Prior torch.cuda.synchronize is outside timing; native-equivalent pageable CPU to(device) uses default non_blocking=False; length tensor construction copies CPU data; item() and cpu().numpy().tobytes() return CPU-visible data. Includes own runtime/copy completion, excludes encode/decode, NCCL and later receive allocation. Microbenchmark, not engine validation. A input preparation starts after prior device synchronize outside timing; ends after own device synchronize, covering CPU organization, block/input copies, positions, seq lengths, slot mapping and logits indices only. No NCCL/model layer work. Explicit completion sync is included; measurement changes overlap and is not native step timing.
